native_review.oracle_audit: Checked contract text for quantity 1 to 1000000000 inclusive with resulting balances allowed to exceed that per-event bound, not the prior 1e6 prose error; checked reserved.py over-max 10**9+1, balance-beyond 2*10**9, typed judge with exact bool/int/float distinction, duplicate-key/NaN/Infinity rejection, framing startswith { and endswith }\n, exit 2 with exact stderr, closed replay and uncertain-handle paths, and 11/10/10/12/10/10 equals 63. Domain-oracle values for public examples, depletion idempotence, order, whitespace/CRLF, missing-final-LF, escaped CR/LF, 65536/65537 bytes and 1000/1001 events match the contract text as far as supplied; from/to string boundaries and enforced non-root test execution do not.
native_review.rationale: Source custody and evaluator framing are substantially complete, but concrete freeze blockers remain: unenforced non-root test transport, missing from/to 64-byte boundary рецепты, and over-broad yet incomplete study-script binding. Missing accepted receipt or registration is not counted as a defect because those are post-review coordinator actions. Only six SQLite primitive observations exist; there is no full-programme baseline and none is claimed. Later N/S/T plus ablation comparison under software_comparison_v3/protocol-draft.md remains an unregistered draft with its own contracts, rubrics, harnesses, images and review required before any comparative generation.
